GET STARTED

Small APIs.
Expressive interfaces.

It only takes a few lines of Motion to bring an interface to life in React, JavaScript or Vue. Learn once, build anything.

RUNWAY
BACKSTAGE
OBJECTS
Layout animations

Animate changes to size, position and order that CSS can’t, even from one component to another, with fast transforms.

<motion.img layoutId={id} onClick={() => setOpen(id)} />

<AnimatePresence>
  {open && <motion.img layoutId={open} className="detail" />}
</AnimatePresence>
LAYOUT DOCS
LAYOUT EXAMPLES
Gesture animations

Gestures that feel native. Press works from the keyboard, hover ignores touch, and drag throws with momentum.

<motion.div
  drag
  dragSnapToOrigin
  whileHover={{ scale: 1.1 }}
  whileTap={{ scale: 1 }}
  whileDrag={{ scale: 1.2 }}
/>
GESTURES DOCS
GESTURES EXAMPLES
0%
Scroll animations

Link any value to scroll progress. Motion uses the browser’s ScrollTimeline when possible for smooth, hardware-accelerated scroll effects.

const { scrollXProgress } = useScroll({ container })

<motion.div style={{ scaleX: scrollXProgress }} />

SCROLL EXAMPLES

Physics springs that carry velocity. A value follows its target with real stiffness, damping and mass, and stays fluid when the target moves again mid-flight.
